# Gramlot 0.3.17

- Unify HTML and component label presentation through the renderer-owned Labelbox, preserving Source, Data and content identity.
- Add trayPane arrangements in a Data Bag: movement, resize, layers with contact constraints, selection and group movement, rectangle selection, rotation, zoom, locking and optional Shift snapping.
- Consolidate reviewed lifecycle, editor updates, shared tree search, IndexPage/IDE ownership and detachable presentation corrections.
- Re-export the shared Toolbox date-expression parser while preserving the public API.
- Retain current browser APIs as the supported path; no legacy-browser fallback is added.

Known limits: tray arrangement uses transformed outer rectangles, excluding shadows and rounded corners. Gallery Save layout is an in-page Bag snapshot, not durable server storage. Remaining documented audit debts are not represented as closed by this release.
